authors_structure.note: even slots = hourly values (0.1 degC precision except gap-filled hours), odd slots = exact mid-points (linear interpolation), last slot of the year clamped; off-grid even values (thirds, halves) are hours filled by linear interpolation across missing observations.

temperature.offset_convention: our slot i = ERA5 interpolated at t_i + offset*30min (t_i in UTC)
temperature.selection_rule: minimum RMSE among the 5 prescribed candidates x integer offsets -2..+2; 'extra_*' rows are sensitivity only

chosen_diagnostics.last_slot_note: the authors clamp 31 Dec 23:30 to the 23:00 value; ours interpolates with ERA5 2014-01-01 00:00 (available in the file)

normalization.recipe: temp_smooth_n = (temp_smooth - min) / (max - min) over the 365 days

pca_authors.recipe: PCA of the 365x48 half-hourly temperatures only (centred, not standardised, fitted on all 365 days, scikit-learn<1.5 u-based sign convention), then ONE global min-max over the 365x3 score matrix
pca_authors.paper_claim: 3 components explain 98% of the variance (PCA on 48 temps + smoothed temp)

ours_vs_authors.note: our PCA is fitted on our own 365x48 ERA5 matrix (authors' recipe); component signs are aligned to the authors' loadings (positive dot product) before the global min-max, so that the scaled values are comparable

pos_y.recipe: daily pandas row mean of i/17519, i = 0..17519 (0 at 1 Jan 00:00, 1 at 31 Dec 23:30)

tariffs.offset_convention: result[g] = mapped_xlsx[g - offset]: positive offset = events later; mode 'gmt' = xlsx timestamps taken as GMT; 'local' = xlsx timestamps are Europe/London clock time converted to GMT

metric_definitions.event_jaccard: Jaccard index of the (slot, label) event pairs, Low and High pooled
metric_definitions.slot_agreement: share of half-hour slots with the same label (Normal included)
metric_definitions.event_days_identical: days with an event in either set whose 48-slot profile is identical

gmt.rule: best event_jaccard vs authors over the GMT period (Jan 1-Mar 30, Oct 27-Dec 31)

loc.rule: best event_jaccard vs authors over the whole year

chosen_versions.warning: chosen by agreement with the authors' file only; which alignment is physically right is decided elsewhere (consumption event study)

parquet.columns_note: date; temp_00..47, temp_smooth, temp_smooth_n, pca_temp_0..2, pos_y, work_day (ours, authors' recipes); low_/high_/price_{auth,gmt,loc}_00..47. Unsuffixed low_/high_/price_ columns are intentionally absent: pick a version with lib.tariffs.select_tariff_version.
